text: - The panel shows the clicked post cloned as the OP, then subscribes live via NDK for `kind:1` events tagging that note's id across four public relays, rendering each as a `.post`-styled reply card (avatar, name/nip05, relative timestamp, content, its own "view on nostr" link) — a flat, Twitter-style conversation view. [...] One known simplification worth flagging: it fetches *all* kind:1 events tagging the post via `#e`, without NIP-10 marker filtering — so a rare quote-post that merely mentions the note (rather than replying to it) could show up alongside true replies. Not seen in testing, but possible. Say if you want that tightened.
